title: Latvia - 2026.08.08
notes: Latvia is confronting simultaneous crises on two fronts: repeated drone incursions and hybrid-threat warnings that have exposed gaps in the country's air-defense readiness, and a deteriorating fiscal outlook that is forcing the government to cut spending even as security demands grow. The combination is testing both the credibility of Latvia's NATO commitments and the government's ability to maintain public services. Officials in Riga face the difficult task of reassuring citizens on safety while tightening the national budget.
